tools.name: trip_brief
tools.description: Use before booking or confirming an international trip for a traveller: one call returns the visa rule for passport -> destination with an over-stay check against the dates, the US State Department level and UK FCDO alerts, public holidays inside the dates, the live exchange rate, Schengen specifics

tools.name: travel_advisory
tools.description: Use for safety / duty-of-care screening of one destination: US advisory level 1-4 with summary, dates and link, UK FCDO alert status (advice against all / all-but-essential travel to all or parts), latest change, warnings and the entry-requirements excerpt, plus a combined headline. Optional: countr

tools.name: advisory_changes
tools.description: Use daily for travel-risk monitoring: every US State Department advisory reissued/updated and every UK FCDO travel advice update in the window, newest first, with the current US level and each government's own change note, plus a per-country roll-up. One call replaces polling ~200 countries x 2 gove

tools.name: visa_check
tools.description: Use when a traveller's nationality and destination(s) are known: visa-free / ETA / e-Visa / visa on arrival / visa required / no admission, max visa-free stay in days, what to do next and the official source. Omit destination for the passport's full map. Optional: passport, destination. PAID: $0.020

tools.name: day_pass
tools.description: Use if you will make more than ~7 trip briefs or ~25 other calls in a day. Returns a bearer token valid 24 h (300 successful calls) for every paid tool here: send it as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>, or as the "pass" argument, and you are not charged again. tools.name: visa_peek
tools.description: FREE preview: the visa category only (visa-free / ETA / e-Visa / on arrival / required / no admission) for one passport and one destination. visa_check adds stay length, official source and up to 25 destinations; trip_brief adds advisories, holidays, FX and a checklist.

tools.name: payment_options
tools.description: FREE. Prices, the receiving address and the exact retry format for x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) and MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo), the Trip Desk Pass, and the plain-USDC-transfer option (no x402 client needed: 1 USDC = 24 h, 5 USDC = 7 days), plus the equivalent HTTP endpoints.

tools.name: redeem_transfer_pass
